mapper.select: SELECT id, creator_id, approver_id, status, remark, create_time, approve_time, update_time FROM stock_replenish_order WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_replenish_order SET status = #{status}, approver_id = #{approverId}, remark = #{remark}, approve_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE stock_replenish_order SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.creator_id, sc.name AS creator_name, o.approver_id, sa.name AS approver_name, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time, o.approve_time, COUNT(l.product_id) AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM stock_replenish_order o LEFT JOIN stock_replenish_log l ON l.id = o.id LEFT JOIN staff sc ON sc.id = o.creator_id LEFT JOIN staff sa ON sa.id = o.approver_id WHERE o.id = #{id} GROUP BY o.id, o.creator_id, sc.name, o.approver_id, sa.name, o.status, o.remark, o.create_time, o.approve_time
